It represents the idea of 'Vasudeva Kutumbakam', meaning the whole world is one family, while at the same time emphasizing the unique identity and uniqueness of each individual.

By embracing our individuality while acknowledging our oneness with all beings, we can live a meaningful and fulfilling life grounded in both spirit and culture.
